content:
alex: FYI I just hit a weird header leak on canary routing. repro attached.

alex: repro steps: 1) POST /v1/generate with header X-Tenant-Id: 9876 2) add ?force=fallback to trigger cheap pool 3) inspect outbound request to fallback.

alex: proxy log:```
[2026-03-18T16:05:12Z] proxy: recv /v1/generate headers={"X-Tenant-Id":"9876","X-Req":"r-xyz"}
[2026-03-18T16:05:12Z] rl-router: selected pool=fallback-cheap tags=[cheap,us-east-1]
[2026-03-18T16:05:12Z] fallback-proxy: outbound /infer headers={"X-Orig-Tenant":"9876"}
```

alex: so we add X-Orig-Tenant for tracing but we never scrub before hitting fallback pools. could expose tenant id to another tenant's pool or to logs.

sophia: is sanitize_outbound_headers supposed to be on?

max: normally it's true. canary toggled it off for perf testing. bad timing.

max: question: who injects X-Orig-Tenant, proxy or router? logs show both. infra-bot: deploy canary 0.4.7 -> fallback-test

infra-bot: deploy accepted: canary 0.4.7 -> fallback-test (8 instances) :rocket:

lina: confirmed on local: outbound to fallback includes X-Orig-Tenant in headers and in some metadata fields. no PII in model payload, but header leak exists.

alex: impact: telemetry/log pipelines might persist this header. need to treat as cross-tenant metadata leak.

max: proposed fixes: 1) flip sanitize_outbound_headers back on for canary immediately 2) add routing-time scrub when routing to pool with tenant mismatch 3) add e2e CI test.

sophia: i like the routing-time scrub. add X-Tenant-Scrubbed=true header when we scrub for auditing.

alex: quick patch idea:```diff
--- a/rl-router/src/route.rs
+++ b/rl-router/src/route.rs
@@
-    let hdrs = req.headers.clone();
+    let mut hdrs = req.headers.clone();
+    if routing_ctx.target_pool_owner != req.tenant {
+        hdrs.remove("X-Tenant-Id");
+        hdrs.insert("X-Tenant-Scrubbed", "true");
+    }
     send_to_pool(hdrs, payload);
```

max: we should also add an e2e harness that forces fallback and inspects mock fallback receiver for tenant headers. put under ci/routing-e2e and make it lightweight.

lina: i'll own the e2e and mock receiver. i'll add a test that POSTs with tenant 9876 and asserts outbound does not contain tenant headers.

sophia: also run a quick scan of rl-proxy-logs kafka topic for past X-Orig-Tenant occurrences. if we find persisted ones, coordinate with infra to scrub or rotate.

max: running query now: `select timestamp, headers from rl-proxy-logs where headers like '%X-Orig-Tenant%' limit 50` — will post results in ~30m.

infra-bot: rolling canary rollback for canary 0.4.7 -> fallback-test

alex: thanks. will open a follow-up RFC for routing toggles so perf experiments don't disable security defaults. cc @security for visibility.

sophia: once hotfix lands let's schedule a 15m sync and add a checklist item for any routing toggle flips. :memo:
